scenario: PROOF-4 TurboVec retrieval on a real corpus
corpus: 107 real documents (the platform's journal articles + docs), 2153-term vocabulary
query: held-out odd half of each document; ground truth exact by construction
verdict: PROVEN: the 16x compression claim is EXACT (921484/57673 = 16.0). NOT PROVEN: that it preserves retrieval. recall@1 collapses 100.0% -> 18.7%, an 81.3-point loss, and recall@3 100% -> 40.2%. 18.7% is far above chance (0.93%) so the representation retains real signal, but '16x smaller' and 'works as well' are different claims and only the first is true here.
BUG_FOUND_IN_MY_OWN_HARNESS: first run reported recall@1 0.9% == chance AT FULL PRECISION, which is impossible for a self-match and indicted the harness. Cause: the loop skipped even k WITHOUT incrementing k, so k stayed 0, every token was skipped, and the query vector was all zeros. Fixed, and a non-vacuity guard added so a zero query cannot silently produce a score.
